title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees: Fee Posting, Late Registration and Meal-Status Fee Waivers under Texas Education Code 11.158
content:
These terms of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** govern when each fee component of a participation posts, when a late registration fee is added, and how meal-status fee waivers reduce fees.

## 1. Posting of fee components (earlier text, clause retired)

> On the registration date every fee component the type carries posts as its own fee: the participation fee, the travel fee, the uniform package fee, and for a trip the trip deposit and the trip balance fee; a component whose catalogue amount is 0.00 posts nothing.

This clause is **no longer in force** in this form. The current basis is:

- a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03 posts its participation fee on the date the parent or guardian submits the signed participation packet, at the amount the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics fee schedule sets, and its travel fee only under the UIL travel fee schedule, on the date that fee is posted;
- a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03 posts its participation fee on the date the parent or guardian submits the signed participation packet, at the amount the 2026-27 Fine Arts fee schedule sets, its travel fee only under the Fine Arts travel fee schedule and its uniform package, as the concert attire package, only under the Fine Arts concert attire schedule, each on the date it is posted;
- every other participation posts every fee component the type carries as its own fee on the registration date at its catalogue amount, a component whose catalogue amount is 0.00 posting nothing.

## 2. Late registration (earlier text, clause retired)

> A registration received later than the type's registration deadline days before the season's first practice or event date, or for a trip later than that many days before departure, also posts the late registration fee.

This clause is **no longer in force** in this form. The current basis: a UIL Academic and Robotics Team or Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03 posts no late registration fee; every other registration received later than the registration deadline days before the season's first practice or event date, or for a trip later than that many days before departure, also posts the late registration fee.

*Boundary (hypothetical, deadline of 14 days, season start on day S):* a registration received on day S minus 14 is not late; one received on day S minus 13 is late.

## 3. Meal-status fee waivers (in force)

Fee waivers follow Texas Education Code 11.158 through the student's School Nutrition meal status on the posting date. A student holding any Free Meal Status tier is credited the type's free-meal waiver share of each waivable fee, as a free-meal waiver credit; a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier is credited the type's reduced-price waiver share, as a reduced-price meal waiver credit. Each waiver credit is the fee multiplied by the share, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

**Waivable components.** Participation, travel and trip fees are waivable; a uniform package is waivable only where the catalogue marks the type's uniform package as reduced by meal-status waivers; late registration fees and equipment charges are never waivable.

**Meal status after posting.** A meal status determined after a fee posted does not change that fee.

**Due period.** Fees are due within the type's fee due days, calendar days of posting, unless the installment plan applies.

*Worked illustration (hypothetical):* a waivable fee of 37.45 for a student holding a Reduced-Price Meal Status tier on the posting date, at a 50 percent share, gives 18.725, credited as 18.73.
